sn22.26:1.13: That feeling is impermanent, suffering, and perishable: this is its drawback.
sn22.26:1.14: Removing and giving up desire and greed for feeling: this is its escape.
sn22.26:1.17: Those choices are impermanent, suffering, and perishable: this is their drawback.
sn22.26:1.18: Removing and giving up desire and greed for choices: this is their escape.
sn22.26:2.3: Then, mendicants, I announced in this world with its gods, Māras, and divinities, this population with its ascetics and brahmins, its gods and humans: “I have attained supreme perfect enlightenment.”
